bullets.title: NVDA: $3.5B MediaTek investment deepens NVLink ecosystem; AVGO faces longer-term XPU headwind
bullets.body: NVIDIA invested $3.5B in MediaTek convertible bonds and announced expanded NVLink Fusion partnership, positioning custom ASICs into its rack-scale AI factory ecosystem. Analysts flagged this as a kingmaker move for next-gen ASIC partners (MRVL) while posing a longer-term threat to AVGO's custom XPU franchise—though near-term AVGO impact seen as limited. NVIDIA CEO Huang also highlighted the Vera Rubin platform generating $40B revenue per GW, underscoring AI infrastructure monetization density.

bullets.title: AVGO Q3 earnings preview: AI semis guidance cut 4.8% vs consensus; JPM stays bullish
bullets.body: AVGO Q3 consensus shows revenue of $29.24B vs guidance (slight miss) and AI Semis revenue of $15.23B vs $16B consensus (4.8% miss), though Q4 guidance of $34.68B with $20.93B AI Semis and $16.86B FCF is robust. UBS trims FY27 AI revenue by $5B to ~$130B, estimating Anthropic TPU shipments at $2.5B in FQ3 ramping to $3.3B in FQ4. JPMorgan maintains bullish stance ahead of earnings, arguing AI momentum is underestimated and GOOGL TPU competition concerns are overblown; options imply ~8.1% move.

bullets.title: DELL F2Q27 preview: Street eyes $44.9B revenue, +76% ISG growth on AI server momentum
bullets.body: UBS raises DELL FQ2 revenue estimate to $46B/$4.97 EPS vs consensus $45.1B/$4.90, lifting AI server forecast to $16B and FY27 AI revenue to $66.9B from $60.6B. StreetAccount consensus expects $44.898B revenue (above $44.5B guidance midpoint), 17.3% gross margin, and $4.92 EPS. Key focus areas include AI server demand momentum, traditional server competitive dynamics, and PC refresh activity.

bullets.title: HPE Q3 preview: Sept 2 earnings; consensus $11.95B revenue, $0.93 EPS; networking +72-75% y/y
bullets.body: HPE reports Q3 on September 2 post-close; FactSet consensus: $11.95B revenue vs guidance $11.5-12.1B and $0.93 EPS at the top of guidance range. FY guidance implies 29-33% revenue growth and 80-85% operating income growth, with FCF of at least $3.5B. Options imply ~11.4% post-earnings move; HPE has beaten EPS consensus 16 of past 20 quarters. UBS expects broad-based beat & raise but notes elevated 14x valuation limits multiple expansion.

bullets.title: MDB: Hedgeye initiates long with $579 PT (+30%); thesis hinges on net ARR expansion trajectory
bullets.body: Hedgeye launches long MDB with $579 PT (50x FY28E EBITDA, no multiple expansion required), citing Atlas growth at 29%+ for four consecutive quarters after troughing at 24%, platform attach rising from 37% to 45% among $100K+ customers, and 34 consecutive quarters of beating guidance. Key risk: consensus models zero beat into FY27 and 2H FY27 implied growth of only 16% vs. 25% in 1H due to Enterprise Advanced contract lap. Flat net ARR expansion in the most recent quarter is described as a thesis-ender if it doesn't inflect. UBS rates MDB at 9x CY27 revs with no tangible AI pull-through yet, and competitive pressure from Microsoft/AWS/Postgres intensifying.

bullets.title: AAPL leadership transition: Cook exits, Ternus becomes CEO; Phil Schiller resigns from App Store
bullets.body: Tim Cook's final day as Apple CEO is today; John Ternus (hardware chief) assumes CEO role September 1, with Cook transitioning to executive chairman. Phil Schiller simultaneously resigned from his roles overseeing the App Store and events, retaining Apple Fellow status. JPM maintains Overweight on AAPL; IDC cuts 2026 smartphone market by 16.7% but Apple's iOS share forecast to hit a record 23.6% at 243.8M units (+1.3% y/y) as sub-$100 segment collapses. JPM models 7.5M foldable units in CY26. Stock down ~0.9% on the day amid hardware sector weakness.

bullets.title: AMZN: FTC sues over advertiser price manipulation; Piper reiterates OW at $320
bullets.body: The FTC filed suit against Amazon alleging manipulation of prices charged to retail platform advertisers; Amazon disputed the claims, citing flat real CPC from 2019-2024, $8B in advertiser savings 2021-2025, and 58% higher sales ROI under its relevancy model. Stock fell 2.5% on the day. Separately, Piper Sandler reiterated Overweight at $320 PT citing Amazon as best-positioned for AI spending with ~14% 2026 ROIC expected.

bullets.title: SNOW: UBS bullish on strong Cortex AI pull-through supporting 38-40% FY growth
bullets.body: UBS highlights SNOW as showing real AI momentum with strong Cortex adoption; enterprise channel checks flag accelerating spend with demand trends supporting 38-40% FY growth targets. Wolfe Research webcast also covered SNOW earnings preview in its weekly TMT session.

bullets.title: PINS: CFO Donnelly resigns effective Oct 30; stock -6.4%
bullets.body: Pinterest CFO Julia Brau Donnelly announced resignation effective October 30, 2026; company stressed departure was unrelated to disagreement. Stock fell 6.4% on the session, making it the worst performer in internet sector on the day.

bullets.title: CRWD: +5.8% on Google Cloud Falcon platform availability; CrowdStrike-SNOW partnership announced
bullets.body: CrowdStrike gained 5.8% after announcing Falcon platform availability on Google Cloud. At its flagship conference, CrowdStrike also announced partnerships with Google and Snowflake. GS TMT noted CRWD up ~52% in August but cyber sector valuations look stretched per analyst commentary.

bullets.title: TSLA: +4.5% to one-week high; bullish options flow; FSD ubiquity thesis building
bullets.body: TSLA was the 'upside standout' in an otherwise flat session, gaining 4.5% to a one-week high with the most bullish options flow on the day. A long-time Tesla bull noted valuation appears stretched. Social commentary highlighted FSD entering an era of ubiquity and becoming a standard feature, though bears note 2026 EV sales flat at ~1.6M for a third consecutive year.

bullets.title: JPM tactically cautious: rotate from AI/Semis to Mag7/Software; hedge via VIX and credit shorts
bullets.body: JPMorgan's trading desk shifted to Tactically Cautious/Neutral on US equities, citing: (i) 54-60% odds of Fed hike in September if Warsh stance holds, (ii) Momentum down 21-34% from June highs vs typical 10-15% drawdowns, (iii) post-Labor Day credit spread risk, (iv) September seasonality weakness. Desk recommends reducing net longs, favoring Mag7 over AI/Memory/Semis, and hedging with short credit ETFs and long VIX products until the September 16 FOMC. Post-midterm election seasonality historically strong at +5.4% to +14.7% at 3-12 month tenors.

bullets.title: GS August recap: TSLA +18.2%, NVDA +9.8%, MSFT +9.2%; Software (IGV +16.3%) leads; Semis stabilize
bullets.body: August 2026 saw mega-cap tech outperform: NVDA printed blowout earnings with 70% revenue growth guidance for FY28 (100% ex-supply constraints); PLTR beat with AI demand driving US Commercial reacceleration; MRVL beat and raised on new GOOGL production agreement. Software sector very strong (IGV +16.3%), semis stabilized after July (SOX +2.0%). GS TMT notes September catalysts include AAPL event 9/9, CRM Dreamforce 9/15-17, META Connect 9/23-24, BABA Apsara 9/22-24.

bullets.title: DKNG: -3.8% on 9th Circuit ruling keeping sports prediction contracts out of Nevada
bullets.body: DraftKings fell 3.8% after the 9th Circuit ruled against Kalshi, keeping sports prediction contracts out of Nevada. Resolution expected to take 1-2 years. Separately, DKNG held 35.2% of NY OSB handle in July (up 37bps MoM) with handle +30% y/y and GGR +39% y/y, though Q2 NY OSB showed deceleration with DKNG GGR -15% y/y.

bullets.title: RBLX: +7.1% after EU designates it as 'Very Large' platform under Digital Services Act
bullets.body: Roblox gained 7.1% on the session after the EU flagged it for higher Digital Services Act scrutiny, classifying it as a 'Very Large Online Platform' alongside ChatGPT and Reddit. The designation typically signals regulatory focus, but market interpreted as a validation of platform scale.

bullets.title: AMD + CSCO: MI355X live in Saudi Arabia with HUMAIN; 250 MW AI buildout by 2027
bullets.body: AMD Instinct MI355X GPU systems are now live in Saudi Arabia with Cisco Silicon One 800G networking, operated by HUMAIN (PIF). AMD, Cisco, and HUMAIN plan to install up to 250 MW of AI infrastructure by 2027. AMD gained 1.1% on the session.

bullets.title: CHTR: CFO Fischer stepping down Oct 15; Howard named interim; no guidance changes
bullets.body: Charter Communications CFO Jessica Fischer is stepping down effective October 15, 2026. Kevin Howard (EVP, Chief Accounting Officer & Controller) named interim CFO while a comprehensive permanent CFO search begins. Company confirmed no changes to previously provided financial outlook or financial policy.

bullets.title: MRVL: at 100-day MA ahead of October 6 analyst day; CEO signaling key announcements reserved
bullets.body: MRVL is trading at its 100-day moving average ahead of its analyst day on October 6, 2026. CEO Matt Murphy has indicated key news will be reserved for the analyst day rather than previewed at earnings. AIDC demand is running at 2x deliverable supply with MRVL optics performance driving recent estimate raises.

bullets.title: CRM: up 50% since May 15 SaaS comeback call; Salesforce Dreamforce Sept 15-17 key catalyst
bullets.body: Salesforce has rallied approximately 50% since Chamath's May 15 bullish SaaS call, validating the high-end SaaS recovery thesis. GS TMT flags CRM Dreamforce (September 15-17) as a key September catalyst. Hedgeye notes application software companies like Salesforce face lower-growth reset risks with unresolved AI disruption.

bullets.title: GEV: Venezuela energy deal nearing; SpaceX turbine threat seen as overstated by SPCX analysis
bullets.body: GE Vernova is among companies nearing final energy agreements with Venezuela under revised hydrocarbon law, potentially expanding oil production. Separately, analysis of SpaceX's turbine foundry plan concludes it is likely limited to aeroderivative spares for its own fleet; structural moats in single-crystal casting and ceramic core production at GEV remain intact. SpaceX lacks strategic motivation for IGT scale-up, and the current sell-off appears overdone.
